node.statement: Using node 1.6.1.1.2 and validated node 1.4, h*a-r^2=(h*a-b)+(b-r^2), so the real triangle inequality gives abs(h*a-r^2)<=abs(h*a-b)+abs(b-r^2)<=C*e*r^2+e*r^2=(C+1)*e*r^2. This derivation uses the newly allowed row-column external for the first premise and does not claim that blocked node 1.3 proves it.
